properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 4:14AM EDT until August 10 at 5:15AM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
SVRIND

The National Weather Service in Indianapolis has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Tippecanoe County in west central Indiana...
Clinton County in central Indiana...
Central Boone County in central Indiana...
Montgomery County in west central Indiana...

* Until 515 AM EDT.

* At 413 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 8 miles east of Lafayette to 12 miles south of West
Lafayette to 13 miles northwest of Crawfordsville, moving southeast
at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Frankfort, Crawfordsville, Lebanon, Thorntown, Dayton, Mulberry,
Waynetown, Darlington, Kirklin, Linden, Colfax, Clarks Hill,
Advance, Michigantown, New Ross, New Richmond, Wingate, and Ulen.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 65 between mile markers 137 and 168.
Interstate 74 between mile markers 24 and 50.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 12:29AM MST until August 10 at 2:45AM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
FFWPSR

The National Weather Service in Phoenix has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Maricopa County in south central Arizona...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 245 AM MST.

* At 1229 AM MST, gauge reports indicated thunderstorm runoff
continuing to travel downstream within Vekol Wash. A streamflow
gauge at I-8 measured a flow of 1100 cfs at 12:10 AM MST and flow
was declining. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ak-Chin Indian Community and Freeman.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Vekol Wash.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.areaDesc: Grundy, IL; La Salle, IL; Livingston, IL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 10 at 2:32AM CDT until August 10 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Livingston County in central Illinois...
East Central La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Southern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 700 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Flooding
may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Slow moving or standing
water may continue. High water likely may recede slowly from
flooded areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 228 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated that heavy rainfall had
moved out of the area. Rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches occurred
across the area, with rainfall in excess of 4 inches observed
near Dwight. Water will be slow to recede from fields, yards, and
poor drainage areas. Some streams may continue to rise due to
earlier rainfall as runoff moves downstream.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Ottawa, Streator, Dwight, Gardner, Mazon, Grand Ridge, South
Wilmington, Ransom, Verona, Campus, East Brooklyn and Kinsman.
- This includes the headwaters of the Mazon River, Otter Creek, and
Covel Creek.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Warning means flooding is imminent or may already be
occurring. Persons along rivers, creeks, and other waterways should
take immediate precautions to protect life and property.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 4:16AM EDT until August 10 at 4:30AM EDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
At 415 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Delphi to 7 miles southeast of Lafayette to 9
miles east of Williamsport, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Lafayette, West Lafayette, Williamsport, Attica, Shadeland, Dayton,
Battle Ground, Pine Village, Purdue University, and Rainsville.

This includes Interstate 65 between mile markers 167 and 183.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
